timeline.summary: Zegana delivers the Fathom Edict announcing the rebirth of the Simic.
timeline.quote: Zegana announced the rebirth of the Simic under new philosophical principles

citation.text: "Forum of Azor", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Simic biomancers create the mutants of Ravnica in attempts to improve life forms.
timeline.quote: were responsible for the mutants of Ravnica in their attempts to improve the life forms of that plane.

citation.text: "Mutant", section "Simic". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Under Prime Speaker Vannifar the Simic mutate their more intelligent members into super soldiers.
timeline.quote: the Simic started to mutate their more intelligent members into super soldiers

citation.text: "Mutant", section "Simic". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Momir Vig, dissatisfied with the guild, forms a new purpose of improving Ravnica's life forms and creates cytoplasts.
timeline.quote: formed a new purpose: to improve upon the life forms of Ravnica

citation.text: "Simic Combine", section "Ravnica block". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Simic and Golgari activate Project Kraj, which absorbs cytoplasts across the city.
timeline.quote: Kraj began absorbing cytoplasts from across the city

citation.text: "The Dissension", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Feather becomes Boros guildleader, Leonos II takes over the Azorius, Jarad returns as a lich, and the Simic remain leaderless.
timeline.quote: Feather became the new guildleader of the Boros, Leonos II took the reigns of the Azorius

citation.text: "The Dissension", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sinkholes let Ravnican merfolk resurface and many join the Simic Combine.
timeline.quote: However, massive sinkholes enabled them to resurface, and many have joined the Simic Combine and risen to leadership positions

citation.text: "Merfolk", section "Ravnica". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: With the rediscovery of the oceans through the Zonots, the Simic are remade from scratch, rejecting Vig's philosophy; Zegana becomes guildmaster.
timeline.quote: the Simic were remade from scratch

citation.text: "Simic Combine", section "Return to Ravnica block". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Zegana condemns Momir Vig's hubris and says the merfolk have sought out what remains of the Combine.
timeline.quote: We have sought out what is left of the Combine.

citation.text: "The Fathom Edict". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jan 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Zegana declares the merfolk to be the Simic, ending the Fathom Edict.
timeline.quote: We are the Simic."

citation.text: "The Fathom Edict". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jan 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: A badly injured creature is found on the Northern Interior coast and coaxed into incubation by Stanisil to be healed.
timeline.quote: We coaxed it into incubation in order to heal it, and an unexpected set of reactions began.

citation.text: "Paper Trail". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jun 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The creature, now with hands, records its feelings, resents being studied and fears its freedom.
timeline.quote: I am being studied, and I do not like it.

citation.text: "Paper Trail". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jun 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The narrator, now far stronger and smarter, hears whispers of induction into the Simic Combine and considers returning to help Tin Street.
timeline.quote: I have heard whispers of inducting me into the Simic Combine once the tests are over.

citation.text: "Life is Beautiful", section "8 Prazh 9957 Z.C.". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ral Zarek leads the Izzet against Bolas in the War of the Spark and convinces the Simic to join.
timeline.quote: convinced the Simic Combine to join as well

citation.text: "Simic Combine", section "Guilds of Ravnica block". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Golgari breach Zonot Four and a deep, slow war begins between Simic ecology and Golgari necromancy.
timeline.quote: has been breached and "infected" with Golgari life forms

citation.text: "Simic Combine", section "Zonot Four and the Golgari". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Desperate for money, Leighbet signs up for paid experiments and is transformed by Simic biomancers into a clawed, fanged monster, then flees into the sewers.
timeline.quote: my teeth are reshuffling, becoming jagged and ragged like a mouthful of fangs.

citation.text: "Testing the Dark Waters" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Oct 2018.

timeline.summary: Vannifar's faction loses influence when the Living Guildpact emerges, and she retreats to Zonot Three to continue experimentation.
timeline.quote: Vannifar herself retreated to Zonot Three to continue what she still saw as a pressing matter of guild survival.

citation.text: "Vannifar", section "Prime Speaker". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vannifar makes Zegana's leadership the subject of open debate and is voted the new Prime Speaker.
timeline.quote: A vote was called, and Vannifar was made the new Prime Speaker .

citation.text: "Vannifar", section "Prime Speaker". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The entire Simic Combine aligns with the adaptationists under Vannifar.
timeline.quote: Under Vannifar's leadership, the entirety of the Simic Combine has aligned with the adaptationists .

citation.text: "Vannifar", section "Prime Speaker". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the Phyrexian invasion many Simic and Izzet members willingly undergo compleation, causing distrust from other guilds.
timeline.quote: many Simic willingly underwent compleation to gain more insight into the mutagen

citation.text: "Simic Combine", section "Phyrexian Invasion and its aftermath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Simic offer healing treatments to the maimed victims of partial compleation, using Phyrexian oil research.
timeline.quote: the Simic offered healing treatments to work themselves back into the good graces

citation.text: "Simic Combine", section "Phyrexian Invasion and its aftermath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vraska welcomes curious Simic and Izzet volunteers while others flee in terror.
timeline.quote: I motion to welcome them.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Ravnica: One and the Same

citation.text: "Undercity (Ravnica)", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion many Simic become Phyrexianized; Vannifar and Zegana settle their grievances and Zegana researches a cure.

citation.text: "Vannifar", section "Murders". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
